title: A force is a push or a pull
summary: A force is a push or a pull on an object, and it has a size and a direction.
body: OpenStax Physics says a force pushes or pulls an object. The object can be a table or a person, and the push or pull can come from a person or from Earth's gravitational pull. Forces differ in size and direction: a cannon's push on a cannonball is large, and a mosquito landing on an arm is small. Urone and Hinrichs published the text on 26 March 2020. This is a classroom definition, not a laboratory log.
